title: RAW UNREVIEWED: one undivided referent displayed as twelve ordered fruits or aspects
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED_NOT_SELECTED_NOT_TESTED. Bonaventure Lignum vitae Prologus1–6 and YaleMS416f1v(c1300) give a concrete alternative to reading every pictured fruit as a different ingredient: one undivided referent has12ordered aspects, with branch-fruits distinct from external citation lobes. This is not evidence for composite botanical recipes and supplies no target gloss.

design.mechanism: One explicitly retained subject is distributed across ordered states/aspects and multiple pictured branch-fruit units; external supporting citations are a different visual relation.
design.unit: One complete historical instruction plus its explicitly attributed manuscript diagram; future exploratory target would be one complete already-admitted account selected by root.
design.contrast: Many independent ingredients or taxa versus one referent with differentiated predicates; also distinguish branch-fruits from citation lobes. Ordinary protagonist narratives remain a serious related rival.
design.prediction: If this specific account is selected, the lower/middle/upper origin-life/passion/glorification sequence and one-referent versus12aspect distinction must survive the whole reading; merely renaming all nodes does not resolve ownership or ordered predicates. Exact12is conditional on this account.
design.scope: Source-grounded raw possibility only; no target read, no target selected, no scores or lexical assignment; not a construction recipe joining different botanical organs.

source_evidence.quote: Verum licet hic fructus unus sit et indiuisus, quia tamen secundum eius multiplices status, dignitates, uirtutes et opera multiformibus consolationibus deuotas animas cibat, quae quidem ad duodenarium numerum reducuntur ; ideo fructus hic ligni uitae quasi sub duodecim saporibus in duodecim ramis gustandus proponitur atque describitur : ut in primo ramusculo mens Christo deuota saporem suauitatis percipiat, praeclaram Saluatoris sui recogitando originem dulcemque natiuitatem ; in secundo ramusculo, dignatiuae [69b] condescensionis conuersationem perhumilem ; in tertio celsitudinem perfectae uirtutis ; in quarto, plenitudinem abundantissimae pietatis ; in quinto, confidentiam, quam habuit in periculo passionis ; in sexto patientiam, quam exhibuit in illatis iniuriis et contumeliis magnis ; in septimo, constantiam quam seruauit in ipso cruciatu et dolore asperrimae crucis ; in octauo, uictoriam, quam assecutus est in conflictu et transitu mortis ; in nono, resurrectionis nouitatem miris dotibus adornatam ; in decimo, ascensionis sublimitatem, spiritualium charismatum diffusiuam ; in undeceimo, aequitatem futuri iudicii ; in duodecimo, aeternitatem diuini regni.

known_counterexplanation: A repeated class can refer to different members; a literal recipe has multiple materials; one actor can recur in an ordinary narrative. No target is currently bound to the source distinctions.
smallest_next_test: At most15minutes root-owned paper comparison of two full conditional readings on one already-admitted account, preserving number scope, visual ownership and directed predicates. No new data or infrastructure.
limits: Complete prologue is a modern Latin edition, not a transcription of the MS416 diagram.
All48 diagram clauses and outer inscriptions not diplomatically collated.
No positive witness for the botanical-composite-recipe question.
